points.description: Initialisation and labelling: data labelled with positive/negative (+/-) classes and the weights initialised (randomly) before training starts.
points.partial_credit: Half only if just one of labelling or weight initialisation is stated explicitly.

points.description: Update rule stated correctly: for a misclassified point (<w,x> <= 0 for the positive-labelled/sign-adjusted sample x(n)), update weights with Δw = eta * x(n) (learning rate times input), i.e. update only on misclassified points.
points.partial_credit: Half if the update Δw = eta*x(n) is given but the misclassification condition (<w,x> <= 0) is missing or wrong, or vice versa.

points.description: Loop structure: the update is applied by iterating over all data points in repeated epochs, in a loop.
Stopping condition: repeat until the weights no longer change (or no misclassifications remain), and note that it converges because the data is linearly separable.
points.partial_credit: Half if only the stop condition or only the convergence reason is given.

rubric.notes: Full marks need all four elements to be explicit and correct: labelling and initialisation, the update rule Δw = eta*x(n) with the condition <w,x> <= 0, the epoch loop over all points, and the stopping condition with the linear-separability convergence reason. Vague wording such as "adjust the weights" earns nothing, and a wrong update rule or condition cancels P2. Ignore syntax; steps and their order matter.
